# Render

> Render builds fast, modern websites with on-site local SEO, plus practical AI
> automation, for small businesses in Morris County, New Jersey. Founder-led by
> Tim Pactwa (Computer Science, Virginia Tech) and Luke Wilkins (Finance,
> Virginia Tech). All pricing is published openly; no sales call is required to
> see a number.

## Services

- Web Design & Development: custom-built, mobile-first websites, live in 2 to 4
  weeks. https://renderlocalwebsites.com/services/web-design
- Local SEO: on-site local SEO standard with every build, plus Google Business
  Profile setup and optimization. https://renderlocalwebsites.com/services/local-seo
- AI Consulting & Automation: after-hours replies, lead routing, review
  requests that send themselves. https://renderlocalwebsites.com/services/ai-automation
- Care Plan: optional monthly maintenance (hosting support, updates, fixes),
  month to month, cancel anytime.

## Pricing (published, USD)

- Starter: $500 build + optional $50/mo Care Plan. 1-3 page website.
- Standard: $750 build + optional $75/mo Care Plan. 4-6 pages with local SEO. Most chosen.
- Premium: $2,000 build + optional $125/mo Care Plan. 7+ pages with booking or lead workflow.
- Custom: scoped per project with a fixed number before commitment (multi-location, e-commerce, AI automation).
- Founding client pricing: these are first-client rates and rise as the portfolio grows.
- Guarantee: the first design direction is free; if it is not right, the client walks away and no deposit is taken.
- Full pricing: https://renderlocalwebsites.com/pricing.md and https://renderlocalwebsites.com/services/web-design

## Service area

Based in Morris County, NJ. Primary towns: Randolph, Denville, Morristown,
Parsippany, Madison. Nearby Morris County towns welcome.
https://renderlocalwebsites.com/service-areas
